verdict.rationale: Square can be driven without a UI through its own token-authenticated SDK and APIs. A personal access token suits unattended production use, and the docs also cover a Sandbox environment, idempotency keys and a locally runnable `npx square-mcp-server start` configured via env vars (SANDBOX, DISALLOW_WRITES, SQUARE_VERSION). However, nothing in the pack documents CI-specific usage, a first-party CLI or headless automation guidance. missing for 10: official CLI or documented CI/pipeline integration guidance, an OpenAPI spec for automation tooling (probe 404), independent or hands-on corroboration of headless/CI use.
